title: Comprehensive conservation profiling enables a robust multiplex RT-qPCR assay for simultaneous pan-detection and serotype discrimination of dengue virus
abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue virus (DENV) remains a critical global health threat, necessitating rapid pan-detection and precise serotyping. In this study, we developed a multiplex real-time RT-qPCR assay for simultaneous detection and identification of DENV1–4. Guided by a systematic genomic conservation analysis of 4,754 sequences, we targeted the highly conserved 5′ untranslated region (5′ UTR) to design one pan-DENV and four serotype-specific primer-probe sets. The assay demonstrated robust analytical performance, with the limit of detection (LOD) ranging from 15.8 to 1.58 × 10 3 copies/mL and the lowest LOD (15.8 copies/mL) observed for serotype I with specific primer-probe sets. There was no cross-reactivity with other common pathogens of the Orthoflavivirus or Alphavirus genus pathogens , and clinical specificity was further validated as 100% using a negative cohort of non-dengue febrile samples. Validation using 53 clinical DENV-positive samples showed 100% concordance with a reference diagnostic kit for serotype identification. While the pan-DENV set served as a high-specificity screening tool with broad reactivity, it exhibited a clinical sensitivity of 88.7%, particularly missing low-titer samples (Ct > 30). This discrepancy, coupled with the superior sensitivity of the serotype-specific sets, suggests the presence of incomplete genomic fragments in acute-phase sera, highlighting the advantage of our 5′ UTR-targeted approach in assessing viral genomic integrity. This dual-layered multiplex assay provides a robust, rapid, and cost-effective tool for clinical diagnosis and epidemiological surveillance. IMPORTANCE Dengue fever is a leading cause of systemic viral disease worldwide. Co-circulation of four distinct serotypes complicates clinical management and increases severe disease risk. Here, we presented a novel multiplex RT-qPCR assay enabling simultaneous pan-DENV detection and serotype identification in two tubes, comprising six reactions including an internal control (IC), thereby streamlining dengue diagnosis. A key innovation is the systematic selection of the 5′ UTR as the diagnostic target, guided by big-data genomic analysis. Unlike assays targeting the 3′ UTR, which may overrepresent viral loads by capturing redundant subgenomic orthoflavivirus RNA (sfRNA), our 5′ UTR-targeted design provides a more stringent measure of genomic integrity. Furthermore, the modular performance of our assay combining broad screening via a pan-DENV set with high-sensitivity subtyping which offers a dual-layer diagnostic framework. This work provides a high-performance tool for timely clinical intervention and enhances our molecular understanding of DENV fragments in clinical specimens.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒 (DENV) 仍然是一个严重的全球健康威胁,需要快速的泛检测和精确的血清分型。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在本研究中,我们开发了一种多重实时 RT-qPCR 检测方法,用于同时检测和鉴定 DENV1-4。
elements_zh.methods: 在对 4,754 个序列进行系统性基因组保守性分析的指导下,我们针对高度保守的 5' 非翻译区 (5' UTR) 设计了一套泛 DENV 和四种血清型特异性引物探针组。
elements_zh.main_results: 使用 53 个临床 DENV 阳性样本进行的验证显示,与血清型鉴定的参考诊断试剂盒 100% 一致。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该检测显示出强大的分析性能,检测限 (LOD) 范围为 15.8 至 1.58 × 10^3 拷贝/mL,并且使用特定引物探针组观察到血清型 I 的最低 LOD(15.8 拷贝/mL)。

title_zh: 全面的保守性分析可实现强大的多重 RT-qPCR 检测,可同时进行 登革病毒 的泛检测和血清型区分
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Dengue virus (DENV) remains a critical global health threat, necessitating rapid pan-detection and precise serotyping. In this study, we developed a multiplex real-time RT-qPCR assay for simultaneous detection and identification of DENV1–4. Guided by a systematic genomic conservation analysis of 4,754 sequences, we targeted the highly conserved 5′ untranslated region (5′ UTR) to design one pan-DENV and four serotype-specific primer-probe sets. The assay demonstrated robust analytical performance, with the limit of detection (LOD) ranging from 15.8 to 1.58 × 10 3 copies/mL and the lowest LOD (15.8 copies/mL) observed for serotype I with specific primer-probe sets. There was no cross-reactivity with other common pathogens of the Orthoflavivirus or Alphavirus genus pathogens , and clinical specificity was further validated as 100% using a negative cohort of non-dengue febrile samples. Validation using 53 clinical DENV-positive samples showed 100% concordance with a reference diagnostic kit for serotype identification. While the pan-DENV set served as a high-specificity screening tool with broad reactivity, it exhibited a clinical sensitivity of 88.7%, particularly missing low-titer samples (Ct > 30). This discrepancy, coupled with the superior sensitivity of the serotype-specific sets, suggests the presence of incomplete genomic fragments in acute-phase sera, highlighting the advantage of our 5′ UTR-targeted approach in assessing viral genomic integrity. This dual-layered multiplex assay provides a robust, rapid, and cost-effective tool for clinical diagnosis and epidemiological surveillance. IMPORTANCE Dengue fever is a leading cause of systemic viral disease worldwide. Co-circulation of four distinct serotypes complicates clinical management and increases severe disease risk. Here, we presented a novel multiplex RT-qPCR assay enabling simultaneous pan-DENV detection and serotype identification in two tubes, comprising six reactions including an internal control (IC), thereby streamlining dengue diagnosis. A key innovation is the systematic selection of the 5′ UTR as the diagnostic target, guided by big-data genomic analysis. Unlike assays targeting the 3′ UTR, which may overrepresent viral loads by capturing redundant subgenomic orthoflavivirus RNA (sfRNA), our 5′ UTR-targeted design provides a more stringent measure of genomic integrity. Furthermore, the modular performance of our assay combining broad screening via a pan-DENV set with high-sensitivity subtyping which offers a dual-layer diagnostic framework. This work provides a high-performance tool for timely clinical intervention and enhances our molecular understanding of DENV fragments in clinical specimens.
abstract_zh: 摘要 登革病毒 (DENV) 仍然是一个严重的全球健康威胁,需要快速的泛检测和精确的血清分型。在本研究中,我们开发了一种多重实时 RT-qPCR 检测方法,用于同时检测和鉴定 DENV1-4。在对 4,754 个序列进行系统性基因组保守性分析的指导下,我们针对高度保守的 5' 非翻译区 (5' UTR) 设计了一套泛 DENV 和四种血清型特异性引物探针组。该检测显示出强大的分析性能,检测限 (LOD) 范围为 15.8 至 1.58 × 10 3 拷贝/mL,并且使用特定引物-探针组观察到血清型 I 的最低 LOD(15.8 拷贝/mL)。与正黄病毒或甲病毒属病原体的其他常见病原体没有交叉反应,并且使用非登革热样本的阴性 队列研究 进一步验证临床特异性为 100%。使用 53 个临床 DENV 阳性样本进行的验证显示,与血清型鉴定的参考诊断试剂盒 100% 一致。虽然泛 DENV 组作为具有广泛反应性的高特异性筛查工具,但其临床敏感性为 88.7%,特别是缺失低滴度样本 (Ct > 30)。这种差异,加上血清型特异性组的卓越灵敏度,表明急性期血清中存在不完整的基因组片段,突出了我们的 5'UTR 靶向方法在评估病毒基因组完整性方面的优势。这种双层多重检测为临床 诊断 和流行病学 监测 提供了强大、快速且经济高效的工具。重要性 登革热 是全球系统性病毒性疾病的主要原因。四种不同血清型的共同循环使临床管理变得复杂并增加了严重疾病的风险。在这里,我们提出了一种新型多重 RT-qPCR 检测,可在两个试管中同时进行泛 DENV 检测和血清型鉴定,包括六个反应,包括内部对照 (IC),从而简化登革热 诊断。一项关键创新是在大数据基因组分析的指导下,系统地选择 5'UTR 作为诊断靶点。与针对 3'UTR 的检测不同,3'UTR 可能通过捕获冗余的亚基因组正黄病毒 RNA (sfRNA) 来过度代表病毒载量,我们的 5'UTR 靶向设计提供了更严格的基因组完整性测量。此外,我们的检测的模块化性能将通过泛 DENV 集进行的广泛筛选与高灵敏度亚型相结合,提供了双层诊断框架。这项工作为及时临床干预提供了高性能工具,并增强了我们对临床标本中 DENV 片段的分子理解。

title: Co-Infection of Dengue, Chikungunya, and West Nile Viruses Among Suspected Febrile Patients in Hodeidah Governorate, Yemen: A Retrospective Laboratory-Based Study
abstract: Arboviral infections have emerged as a significant public health challenge worldwide, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions where environmental conditions support the establishment and expansion of competent mosquito vectors (1). Among the most important mosquito-borne arboviruses affecting human populations are dengue virus (DENV), chikungunya virus (CHIKV), and West Nile virus (WNV), which continue to cause substantial morbidity due to their expanding geographic distribution, recurrent outbreaks, and potential for co-circulation in endemic regions.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Arboviral infections have emerged as a significant public health challenge worldwide, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions where environmental conditions support the establishment and expansion of competent mosquito vectors (A1).
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study investigated co-infections of dengue virus (DENV), chikungunya virus (CHIKV), and West Nile virus (WNV) among suspected febrile patients in Hodeidah Governorate, Yemen, through a retrospective laboratory-based approach (A2).
analysis.methods: The study utilized laboratory-based testing to identify arboviral infections, including molecular assays for DENV, CHIKV, and WNV, and analyzed data from suspected febrile patients in Hodeidah Governorate, Yemen (A2).
analysis.main_results: The study found that co-infections of DENV, CHIKV, and WNV occurred among suspected febrile patients, highlighting the potential for concurrent viral infections in the region (A2).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that co-infections of DENV, CHIKV, and WNV are possible in Hodeidah Governorate, Yemen, and emphasize the need for comprehensive diagnostic approaches in arboviral surveillance (A2).
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results underscore the importance of considering co-infections in arboviral surveillance and diagnosis, particularly in regions with overlapping endemic viruses (A2).
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and potential for underreporting, but the evidence is strong given the direct laboratory-based identification of co-infections (A2).

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to investigate the occurrence of co-infections among suspected febrile patients in Hodeidah Governorate, Yemen, focusing on dengue virus (DENV), chikungunya virus (CHIKV), and West Nile virus (WNV). The research highlights the growing public health challenge posed by arboviral infections, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions where mosquito vectors are prevalent. Through a retrospective laboratory-based approach, the study identified cases of co-infection, emphasizing the need for comprehensive diagnostic strategies. The findings suggest that concurrent viral infections may be more common than previously recognized, which has important implications for surveillance and clinical management. However, the study's limitations include its retrospective nature and potential for underreporting, which may affect the generalizability of the results. Despite these limitations, the evidence is considered strong due to the direct identification of co-infections through laboratory testing. The study contributes to understanding the epidemiology of arboviruses and the importance of considering multiple pathogens in diagnostic protocols.

elements_en.methods: The study utilized laboratory-based testing to identify arboviral infections, including molecular assays for DENV, CHIKV, and WNV, and analyzed data from suspected febrile patients in Hodeidah Governorate, Yemen (A2).
elements_en.main_results: The study found that co-infections of DENV, CHIKV, and WNV occurred among suspected febrile patients, highlighting the potential for concurrent viral infections in the region (A2).
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that co-infections of DENV, CHIKV, and WNV are possible in Hodeidah Governorate, Yemen, and emphasize the need for comprehensive diagnostic approaches in arboviral surveillance (A2).
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results underscore the importance of considering co-infections in arboviral surveillance and diagnosis, particularly in regions with overlapping endemic viruses (A2).
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design and potential for underreporting, but the evidence is strong given the direct laboratory-based identification of co-infections (A2).

elements_zh.methods: 该研究利用基于实验室的检测来识别虫媒病毒感染,包括对 DENV、CHIKV 和 WNV 进行分子检测,并分析了也门荷台达省疑似发热患者的数据 (A2)。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现,疑似发热患者中出现了 DENV、CHIKV 和 WNV 的混合感染,凸显了该地区同时发生病毒感染的可能性 (A2)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,也门荷台达省可能存在 DENV、CHIKV 和 WNV 的混合感染,并强调需要对虫媒病毒 监测 采取综合诊断方法 (A2)。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果强调了考虑虫媒病毒 监测 和 诊断 联合感染的重要性,特别是在具有重叠地方性病毒的地区 (A2)。

title_zh: 也门荷台达省疑似发热患者同时感染登革热、基孔肯雅热和西尼罗病毒:一项基于实验室的回顾性研究
source_body_en: Arboviral infections have emerged as a significant public health challenge worldwide, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions where environmental conditions support the establishment and expansion of competent mosquito vectors (1). Among the most important mosquito-borne arboviruses affecting human populations are dengue virus (DENV), chikungunya virus (CHIKV), and West Nile virus (WNV), which continue to cause substantial morbidity due to their expanding geographic distribution, recurrent outbreaks, and potential for co-circulation in endemic regions.
abstract_zh: 虫媒病毒感染已成为全球重大公共卫生挑战,特别是在热带和亚热带地区,这些地区的环境条件支持蚊子 媒介 的建立和扩张 (1)。影响人类群体的最重要的蚊媒虫媒病毒包括 登革病毒 (DENV)、基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 和西尼罗河病毒 (WNV),这些病毒由于其不断扩大的地理分布、反复出现的 暴发 以及在流行地区共同传播的潜力,继续造成大量发病。

title: Một số đặc điểm dịch tễ của trường hợp mắc bệnh và ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết Dengue tại 12 phường thuộc Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, giai đoạn 2022–2025 Epidemiological characteristics of dengue cases and outbreaks in 12 wards of Ho Chi Minh city, 2022–2025
abstract: Nghiên cứu mô tả hồi cứu sử dụng dữ liệu giám sát thường quy gồm 15.085 trường hợp mắc SXHD và 3.722 ổ dịch tại 12 phường của Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh giai đoạn 2022–2025, nhằm mô tả đặc điểm dịch tễ học, hình thức điều trị và đặc điểm ổ dịch của các trường hợp SXHD. Tỷ suất mắc cao nhất năm 2022, đạt 497 ca/100.000 dân với 5.944 trường hợp; năm 2025 tăng trở lại, đạt 401 ca/100.000 dân với 5.102 trường hợp. Long Trường có tỷ suất mắc cao nhất năm 2025 (906 ca/100.000 dân); Bình Trưng và Cát Lái cũng thuộc nhóm có tỷ suất mắc cao. Tỷ lệ SXHD nặng tăng từ 2,8% năm 2022 lên 6,8% năm 2025. Tỷ lệ điều trị nội trú tăng từ 36,3% năm 2022 lên 49,4% năm 2025; OR thô của điều trị nội trú năm 2025 cao hơn năm 2022 (OR thô = 1,71; KTC 95%: 1,58–1,85; p
journal: Tạp chí Y học Dự phòng

title_original: Một số đặc điểm dịch tễ của trường hợp mắc bệnh và ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết Dengue tại 12 phường thuộc Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, giai đoạn 2022–2025 Epidemiological characteristics of dengue cases and outbreaks in 12 wards of Ho Chi Minh city, 2022–2025

analysis.research_question_and_background: Nghiên cứu này nhằm mô tả đặc điểm dịch tễ học, hình thức điều trị và đặc điểm ổ dịch của các trường hợp sốt xuất huyết Dengue (SXHD) tại 12 phường thuộc Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh giai đoạn 2022–2025.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Nghiên cứu mô tả hồi cứu sử dụng dữ liệu giám sát thường quy gồm 15.085 trường hợp mắc SXHD và 3.722 ổ dịch tại 12 phường trong giai đoạn 2022–2025.
analysis.methods: Dữ liệu được thu thập từ hệ thống giám sát thường quy, bao gồm tỷ suất mắc, tỷ lệ điều trị nội trú và các đặc điểm liên quan đến ổ dịch.
analysis.main_results: Tỷ suất mắc cao nhất năm 2022 là 497 ca/100.000 dân với 5.944 trường hợp; năm 2025 tỷ suất mắc giảm xuống 401 ca/100.000 dân với 5.102 trường hợp. Tỷ lệ SXHD nặng tăng từ 2,8% năm 2022 lên 6,8% năm 2025. Tỷ lệ điều trị nội trú tăng từ 36,3% năm 2022 lên 49,4% năm 2025 với OR thô = 1,71 (KTC 95%: 1,58–1,85; p < 0,05).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Nghiên cứu cung cấp cái nhìn về xu hướng dịch tễ học của SXHD trong giai đoạn 2022–2025, đặc biệt là sự gia tăng tỷ lệ SXHD nặng và điều trị nội trú.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Kết quả có thể hỗ trợ trong việc đánh giá nguy cơ dịch và cải thiện các biện pháp phòng ngừa, điều trị tại các khu vực có tỷ suất mắc cao.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Nghiên cứu dựa trên dữ liệu giám sát thường quy, có thể bị ảnh hưởng bởi độ chính xác của báo cáo. Tuy nhiên, dữ liệu được thu thập từ nhiều phường, cho thấy mức độ tin cậy cao.

analysis.summary_en: This study describes the epidemiological characteristics of dengue cases and outbreaks in 12 wards of Ho Chi Minh City from 2022 to 2025. It reports that the highest incidence rate was observed in 2022 at 497 cases per 100,000 people, with a decrease to 401 cases per 100,000 in 2025. The study also highlights an increase in severe dengue cases, rising from 2.8% in 2022 to 6.8% in 2025, and a higher rate of inpatient treatment in 2025 compared to 2022. These findings provide insights into the changing patterns of dengue disease and its management in the region, which could inform public health strategies. However, the study relies on routine surveillance data, which may have limitations in accuracy and completeness.

title: Design of a tetravalent dengue vaccine incorporating T-cell epitopes from NS3 and NS5 proteins and B-cell epitopes from the envelope protein using an immunoinformatics approach
abstract: Dengue virus remains a major global health threat due to its four antigenically diverse serotypes and limited treatment and vaccine options. This study aimed to design and evaluate a rational tetravalent multi-epitope vaccine capable of eliciting broad cross-serotype immune responses against dengue virus. An immunoinformatics-driven strategy was employed to identify CTL, HTL, and B-cell epitopes from the NS3, NS5, and envelope domain III proteins of DENV-1 to DENV-4 based on antigenicity, allergenicity, and predicted immunogenic potential, followed by assessment of HLA population coverage. Among the selected CTL epitopes, three were completely conserved across all four serotypes, while one HTL epitope showed the highest conservation among the selected MHC class II epitopes. High-scoring linear B-cell epitopes were identified across EDIII of all four DENV serotypes, with several closely matching experimentally validated epitopes and predominantly localizing to the FG loop and DIII–DI hinge regions. The combined MHC class I and II population coverage reached 98.05% worldwide. The final vaccine construct comprised 584 amino acids incorporating 11 CTL, 14 HTL, and 7 B-cell epitopes linked to an N-terminal β-defensin adjuvant. Molecular docking, MM/GBSA calculations, and 200 ns molecular dynamics simulations demonstrated stable interactions with both TLR2 and TLR4/MD2 complexes, with docking binding energies of -16.2 and -26.0 kcal/mol and MM/GBSA binding free energies of -27.15 ± 0.54 and -52.50 ± 0.55 kcal/mol, respectively. In silico immune simulation predicted substantial lymphocyte activation, enhanced IFN-γ secretion, predicted antigen clearance, and immunoglobulin class switching. Collectively, the proposed tetravalent multi-epitope vaccine was predicted to provide broad cross-serotype epitope representation, substantial population coverage, and favorable structural and immunological profiles, supporting its potential for further vaccine development. Experimental studies in appropriate in vitro and in vivo models are warranted to further assess its immunogenicity, safety, and protective potential.
journal: Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology

abstract_zh: 由于其四种抗原多样化的血清型以及有限的 治疗 和 疫苗 选项,登革病毒 仍然是全球主要的健康威胁。本研究旨在设计和评估能够引发针对 登革病毒 的广泛交叉血清型 免疫应答 的合理四价多表位 疫苗。采用免疫信息学驱动的策略,根据抗原性、过敏原性和预测的免疫原性潜力,从 NS3、NS5 和 DENV-1 至 DENV-4 的包膜结构域 III 蛋白中识别 CTL、HTL 和 B 细胞表位,然后评估 HLA 群体覆盖率。在选定的 CTL 表位中,三个在所有四种血清型中完全保守,而一个 HTL 表位在选定的 MHC II 类表位中显示出最高的保守性。在所有四种 DENV 血清型的 EDIII 中均鉴定出高分线性 B 细胞表位,其中有几个与实验验证的表位密切匹配,并且主要定位于 FG 环和 DIII-DI 铰链区。全球MHC I类和II类人群覆盖率合计达到98.05%。最终的 疫苗 构建体包含 584 个氨基酸,其中包含 11 个 CTL、14 个 HTL 和 7 个与 N 端 β-防御素佐剂连接的 B 细胞表位。分子对接、MM/GBSA计算和200 ns分子动力学模拟证明了与TLR2和TLR4/MD2复合物的稳定相互作用,对接结合能分别为-16.2和-26.0 kcal/mol,MM/GBSA结合自由能分别为-27.15 ± 0.54和-52.50 ± 0.55 kcal/mol。计算机免疫模拟预测大量淋巴细胞激活、IFN-γ 分泌增强、抗原清除和免疫球蛋白类别转换。总的来说,所提出的四价多表位 疫苗 预计将提供广泛的跨血清型表位代表性、大量群体覆盖以及有利的结构和免疫学特征,支持其进一步开发 疫苗 的潜力。有必要在适当的体外和体内模型中进行实验研究,以进一步评估其免疫原性、安全性和保护潜力。

title: Thực trạng và kết quả xử lý ổ dịch sốt xuất huyết Dengue tại tỉnh Vĩnh Phúc, 2022-2024 Status and response outcomes of Dengue outbreaks in Vinh Phuc province, Vietnam, 2022–2024
abstract: Sốt xuất huyết Dengue (SXHD) vẫn đang là vấn đề sức khỏe cần được quan tâm tại Việt Nam. Nghiêncứu cắt ngang nhằm mô tả thực trạng và kết quả xử lý ổ dịch SXHD tại tỉnh Vĩnh Phúc cũ giai đoạn 2022-2024. Dữ liệu được hồi cứu từ báo cáo ổ dịch và điều tra véc tơ tại Trung tâm Kiểm soát bệnh tật tỉnh VĩnhPhúc. Giai đoạn 2022-2024 ghi nhận 557 ổ dịch, tập trung chủ yếu trong năm 2023 và tại huyện Yên Lạc(30,7%), Vĩnh Tường (29,3%), và Phúc Yên (20,6%). Thời gian phát hiện ổ dịch trung bình 2,02 ngày, cóxu hướng tăng qua các năm. Sau xử lý, 99,8% ổ dịch được kiểm soát trong vòng 14 ngày, và 100% đượcphun hóa chất ít nhất 1 lần. Diệt lăng quăng/bọ gậy kết hợp giám sát véc tơ được triển khai tại 29,4% số ổdịch. Aedes albopictus là véc tơ phát hiện trong các dụng cụ chứa nước. Các chỉ số véc tơ giảm rõ rệt sauxử lý (BI giảm 61,5%, HI giảm 65,2%, DI giảm 90,5%, CSNCM giảm 89,6%). Công tác xử lý ổ dịch đạt tỷ lệkiểm soát cao, nhưng thời gian phát hiện có xu hướng kéo dài và hoạt động kiểm soát véc tơ còn hạn chế.Cần tăng cường nguồn lực chuyên trách và thúc đẩy kiểm soát véc tơ dựa vào cộng đồng.

analysis.summary_en: This study describes the status and response outcomes of Dengue outbreaks in Vinh Phuc province, Vietnam, from 2022 to 2024. It reports that 557 outbreaks were recorded, with the majority occurring in 2023 and concentrated in three districts. The average time to detect outbreaks was 2.02 days, increasing over the years. After intervention, 99.8% of outbreaks were controlled within 14 days, and 100% received at least one pesticide spray. Vector indices decreased significantly following control measures. While outbreak response was effective, the study highlights the need for improved vector control and community-based strategies.

title: Prevalence and factors associated with cardiac involvement in hospitalized patients with dengue: a cross-sectional study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cardiac involvement is an underrecognized but potentially life-threatening complication of dengue fever. We aimed to estimate the prevalence and identify predictors of cardiac involvement among hospitalized patients with dengue. METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional study including 919 patients with confirmed dengue. Cardiac involvement was defined based on clinical features (e.g. chest pain, dyspnoea, syncope), electrocardiogram (ECG) changes, elevated cardiac biomarkers (high-sensitivity troponin I [hs-troponin I] or N-terminal pro-hormone of brain natriuretic peptide) or echocardiographic abnormalities. We performed multivariable logistic regression to identify independent predictors and developed a classification and regression tree (CART) model for risk stratification. RESULTS: Overall, 14% of patients had cardiac involvement such as pericardial effusion (26%), elevated hs-troponin I (38%) and ECG abnormalities (10%). Significant associated factors were age >60 y (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 3.05 [95% confidence interval {CI} 1.53 to 6.08]), warning signs (aOR 2.77 [95% CI 1.76 to 4.37]), anaemia (aOR 1.84 [95% CI 1.16 to 2.95]), thrombocytopenia (aOR 1.82 [95% CI 1.09 to 3.11]), elevated serum creatinine (aOR 2.20 [95% CI 1.34 to 3.60]), hypoalbuminaemia (aOR 3.06 [95% CI 1.74 to 5.57]) and elevated D-dimer levels (aOR 5.90 [95% CI 3.67 to 9.54]). The CART model identified age, warning signs, D-dimer and platelet count as significant predictors. CONCLUSIONS: Cardiac complications are common in dengue and should be considered in the management of high-risk patients.
journal: Transactions of the Royal Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene

abstract_zh: 背景:心脏受累是 登革热 的一种未被充分认识但可能危及生命的并发症。我们的目的是评估 患病率 并确定住院登革热患者心脏受累的预测因素。方法:我们进行了一项横断面研究,纳入了 919 名确诊登革热患者。心脏受累的定义是根据临床特征(例如胸痛、呼吸困难、晕厥)、心电图(ECG)变化、心脏生物标志物升高(高敏肌钙蛋白 I [hs-肌钙蛋白 I] 或脑钠尿肽 N 端激素原)或超声心动图异常。我们进行了多变量逻辑回归来识别独立的预测因子,并开发了用于风险分层的分类和回归树(CART)模型。结果:总体而言,14% 的患者出现心脏受累,例如心包积液 (26%)、hs-肌钙蛋白 I 升高 (38%) 和心电图异常 (10%)。显着相关因素包括年龄 > 60 岁(调整后比值比 [aOR] 3.05 [95% 置信区间 {CI} 1.53 至 6.08])、警告信号(aOR 2.77 [95% CI 1.76 至 4.37])、贫血(aOR 1.84 [95% CI 1.16 至 2.95])、血小板减少症(aOR 1.82 [95% CI 1.09 - 3.11])、血清肌酐升高(aOR 2.20 [95% CI 1.34 - 3.60])、低白蛋白血症(aOR 3.06 [95% CI 1.74 - 5.57])和 D-二聚体水平升高(aOR 5.90 [95% CI 3.67 - 5.57]) 9.54])。CART 模型将年龄、警告信号、D-二聚体和血小板计数确定为重要的预测因素。结论:心脏并发症在登革热中很常见,在高危患者的治疗中应予以考虑。

title: Đặc điểm dịch tễ học các trường hợp tử vong do sốt xuất huyết Dengue tại khu vực phía Nam năm 2022 Epidemiological characteristics of dengue fatal cases in Southern Vietnam, 2022
abstract: Năm 2022, khu vực phía Nam (KVPN) ghi nhận 148 ca tử vong do sốt xuất huyết dengue (SXHD) cao nhất giai đoạn 2001-2025. Tuy nhiên các nghiên cứu về dịch tễ học tử vong SXHD cấp độ toàn khu vực còn hạn chế. Nghiên cứu nhằm mô tả đặc điểm dịch tễ học tử vong do SXHD năm 2022 tại KVPN. Nghiên cứu mô tả hàng loạt ca với 148 ca SXHD tử vong tại KVPN, khởi phát năm 2022. Dữ liệu nhân khẩu học, dịch tễ, bệnh sử, cận lâm sàng được thu thập từ phiếu điều tra tử vong, báo cáo của bệnh viện và Trung tâm kiểm soát bệnh tật tỉnh/thành phố. Sử dụng thống kê mô tả, tỷ lệ tử vong/ mắc trên số ca SXHD được báo cáo để mô tả đặc điểm dịch tễ học của đối tượng. Kết quả cho thấy tử vong do SXHD xảy ra rải rác trong năm, tập trung cao nhất tháng 6,7,8 và phân bố ở 15/20 tỉnh, thành phố KVPN. Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, Bình Dương có số ca tử vong cao nhất lần lượt là 29 ca, 22 ca tuy nhiên, tỷ lệ chết/mắc cao nhất ở Đồng Tháp (0,2%), Bình Dương (0,19%). Ca tử vong tập trung ở nhóm dưới 15 tuổi và 25-44 tuổi. Có 34% ca tiếp cận dịch vụ y tế từ 3 ngày trở lên và trên 65% ca có biến chứng sốc hoặc suy đa tạng. Tử vong do SXHD tại KVPN năm 2022 phân bố không đồng đều giữa các địa phương, lứa tuổi, kèm tình trạng chậm tiếp cận y tế. Các phát hiện cho thấy cần ưu tiên giám sát, phát hiện, quản lý ca bệnh giảm thiểu tử vong.

analysis.methods: Dữ liệu nhân khẩu học, dịch tễ, bệnh sử và cận lâm sàng được thu thập từ phiếu điều tra tử vong, báo cáo của bệnh viện và Trung tâm kiểm soát bệnh tật tỉnh/thành phố. Các phân tích được thực hiện bằng thống kê mô tả, sử dụng tỷ lệ tử vong/mắc để mô tả đặc điểm dịch tễ học.
analysis.main_results: Kết quả cho thấy tử vong do SXHD xảy ra rải rác trong năm, tập trung cao nhất vào tháng 6, 7, 8. Tỷ lệ tử vong/mắc cao nhất ở Đồng Tháp (0,2%) và Bình Dương (0,19%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Các phát hiện cho thấy cần ưu tiên giám sát, phát hiện và quản lý ca bệnh để giảm thiểu tử vong do SXHD tại khu vực phía Nam.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Tình trạng tử vong do SXHD không đồng đều giữa các địa phương và lứa tuổi, kèm theo tình trạng chậm tiếp cận y tế, cho thấy nhu cầu cấp thiết về các biện pháp can thiệp và theo dõi tại khu vực có tỷ lệ tử vong cao.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Kết quả dựa trên dữ liệu mô tả, không có thông tin về các yếu tố nhiễu hoặc kiểm soát, do đó mức độ tin cậy của nghiên cứu được đánh giá là trung bình.

analysis.summary_en: This study describes the epidemiological characteristics of dengue-related deaths in Southern Vietnam in 2022, highlighting the uneven distribution of fatalities across provinces and age groups, with a peak in June, July, and August. The research emphasizes the need for enhanced surveillance and management of dengue cases to reduce mortality. Data were collected through death investigation forms, hospital reports, and local disease control centers, and analyzed using descriptive statistics. The study found that 148 dengue-related deaths were reported, with the highest mortality rates in Đồng Tháp (0.2%) and Bình Dương (0.19%). Over 65% of cases had complications such as shock or multi-organ failure, and 34% of patients accessed healthcare services more than three days after symptom onset. The findings suggest a lack of uniformity in dengue mortality and highlight the importance of timely medical intervention. However, the study is limited to descriptive data without further analysis, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

title_zh: 2022 年越南南部登革热死亡病例的流行病学特征,2022年
source_body_en: Năm 2022, khu vực phía Nam (KVPN) ghi nhận 148 ca tử vong do sốt xuất huyết dengue (SXHD) cao nhất giai đoạn 2001-2025. Tuy nhiên các nghiên cứu về dịch tễ học tử vong SXHD cấp độ toàn khu vực còn hạn chế. Nghiên cứu nhằm mô tả đặc điểm dịch tễ học tử vong do SXHD năm 2022 tại KVPN. Nghiên cứu mô tả hàng loạt ca với 148 ca SXHD tử vong tại KVPN, khởi phát năm 2022. Dữ liệu nhân khẩu học, dịch tễ, bệnh sử, cận lâm sàng được thu thập từ phiếu điều tra tử vong, báo cáo của bệnh viện và Trung tâm kiểm soát bệnh tật tỉnh/thành phố. Sử dụng thống kê mô tả, tỷ lệ tử vong/ mắc trên số ca SXHD được báo cáo để mô tả đặc điểm dịch tễ học của đối tượng. Kết quả cho thấy tử vong do SXHD xảy ra rải rác trong năm, tập trung cao nhất tháng 6,7,8 và phân bố ở 15/20 tỉnh, thành phố KVPN. Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, Bình Dương có số ca tử vong cao nhất lần lượt là 29 ca, 22 ca tuy nhiên, tỷ lệ chết/mắc cao nhất ở Đồng Tháp (0,2%), Bình Dương (0,19%). Ca tử vong tập trung ở nhóm dưới 15 tuổi và 25-44 tuổi. Có 34% ca tiếp cận dịch vụ y tế từ 3 ngày trở lên và trên 65% ca có biến chứng sốc hoặc suy đa tạng. Tử vong do SXHD tại KVPN năm 2022 phân bố không đồng đều giữa các địa phương, lứa tuổi, kèm tình trạng chậm tiếp cận y tế. Các phát hiện cho thấy cần ưu tiên giám sát, phát hiện, quản lý ca bệnh giảm thiểu tử vong.

title: LỊCH SỬ PHÁT TRIỂN VẮC XIN SỐT XUẤT HUYẾT DENGUE VÀ BÀI HỌC CHO CHÍNH SÁCH Y TẾ DỰ PHÒNG HISTORY OF DENGUE VACCINE DEVELOPMENT AND LESSONS FOR PREVENTIVE HEALTHCARE POLICY
abstract: Sự phát triển vắc xin đã chuyển dịch mạnh mẽ từ thực nghiệm sang miễn dịch học phân tử và công nghệ mRNA. Tuy nhiên, sốt xuất huyết Dengue vẫn là thách thức lớn do tồn tại 4 type huyết thanh và hiện tượng tăng cường phụ thuộc kháng thể (ADE) khi kháng thể không trung hòa hỗ trợ vi rút xâm nhập đại thực bào qua thụ thể FcγR, làm tăng nguy cơ bệnh nặng và sốc Dengue. Bài tổng quan hệ thống hóa tiến trình tiến hóa của các nền tảng vắc xin Dengue (sống giảm độc lực, tái tổ hợp, vector virus, mRNA), trọng tâm phân tích các vắc xin chủ đạo gồm Dengvaxia (CYD-TDV), Qdenga (TAK-003) và TV003/TV005. Nghiên cứu đánh giá bài học quản trị y tế và đạo đức từ khủng hoảng Dengvaxia tại Philippines, đồng thời ghi nhận vai trò của Việt Nam trong các thử nghiệm lâm sàng giai đoạn III quốc tế và sự kiện cấp phép vắc xin TAK-003 năm 2024. Phân tích chỉ ra tương lai vắc xin Dengue phụ thuộc vào miễn dịch học hệ thống, trí tuệ nhân tạo, công nghệ nano và miễn dịch cá thể hóa, đặt ra phép thử toàn diện đối với năng lực y tế dự phòng toàn cầu trong thế kỷ XXI.
journal: JOURNAL OF CONTROL VACCINES AND BIOLOGICALS

analysis.research_question_and_background: Nghiên cứu nhằm đánh giá tiến trình phát triển vắc xin sốt xuất huyết Dengue và bài học cho chính sách y tế dự phòng. Sự phát triển vắc xin đã chuyển dịch mạnh mẽ từ thực nghiệm sang miễn dịch học phân tử và công nghệ mRNA.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Nghiên cứu là một bài tổng quan hệ thống hóa tiến trình tiến hóa của các nền tảng vắc xin Dengue, bao gồm các loại vắc xin sống giảm độc lực, tái tổ hợp, vector virus và mRNA. title_zh: LỊCH SỬ PHÁT TRIỂN VẮC XIN SỐT XUẤT HUYẾT 登革热 VÀ BÀI HỌC CHO CHÍNH SÁCH Y TẾ DỰ PHÒNG 登革热历史 疫苗 的发展和预防教训医疗保健政策
source_body_en: Sự phát triển vắc xin đã chuyển dịch mạnh mẽ từ thực nghiệm sang miễn dịch học phân tử và công nghệ mRNA. Tuy nhiên, sốt xuất huyết Dengue vẫn là thách thức lớn do tồn tại 4 type huyết thanh và hiện tượng tăng cường phụ thuộc kháng thể (ADE) khi kháng thể không trung hòa hỗ trợ vi rút xâm nhập đại thực bào qua thụ thể FcγR, làm tăng nguy cơ bệnh nặng và sốc Dengue. Bài tổng quan hệ thống hóa tiến trình tiến hóa của các nền tảng vắc xin Dengue (sống giảm độc lực, tái tổ hợp, vector virus, mRNA), trọng tâm phân tích các vắc xin chủ đạo gồm Dengvaxia (CYD-TDV), Qdenga (TAK-003) và TV003/TV005. Nghiên cứu đánh giá bài học quản trị y tế và đạo đức từ khủng hoảng Dengvaxia tại Philippines, đồng thời ghi nhận vai trò của Việt Nam trong các thử nghiệm lâm sàng giai đoạn III quốc tế và sự kiện cấp phép vắc xin TAK-003 năm 2024. Phân tích chỉ ra tương lai vắc xin Dengue phụ thuộc vào miễn dịch học hệ thống, trí tuệ nhân tạo, công nghệ nano và miễn dịch cá thể hóa, đặt ra phép thử toàn diện đối với năng lực y tế dự phòng toàn cầu trong thế kỷ XXI.
abstract_zh: 疫苗研发已经从实验阶段转向分子免疫学和mRNA技术。然而,登革热仍然是一个重大挑战,因为存在4种血清型,并且当非中和抗体促进病毒入侵巨噬细胞通过FcγR受体时,会出现抗体依赖性增强(ADE)现象,从而增加重症登革热和登革热休克的风险。本综述系统化地回顾了登革病毒疫苗平台的进化过程(包括减毒活疫苗、重组疫苗、媒介病毒和mRNA疫苗),重点分析了主要疫苗,如Dengvaxia(CYD-TDV)、Qdenga(TAK-003)以及TV003/TV005。研究评估了菲律宾登革疫苗危机带来的医疗管理和伦理教训,同时记录了越南在国际三期临床试验和2024年TAK-003疫苗批准事件中的作用。分析表明,登革热疫苗的未来将依赖于系统免疫学、人工智能、纳米技术和个性化免疫,这为21世纪全球疾病预防能力提出了全面的考验。

title: Sự phân bố quần thể muỗi truyền bệnh sốt xuất huyết Dengue và một số yếu tố liên quan ở một số khu vực, tỉnh Đắk Lắk, năm 2025 Distribution of dengue vector populations and associated factors in selected areas of Dak Lak province, 2025
abstract: Nghiên cứu nhằm mục tiêu mô tả sự phân bố quần thể muỗi truyền bệnh sốt xuất huyết Dengue (SXHD)và một số yếu tố liên quan tại một số khu vực tỉnh Đắk Lắk năm 2025. Nghiên cứu cắt ngang thực hiện tại300 hộ gia đình. Sử dụng phiếu theo mẫu của Bộ Y tế để thu thập số liệu véc tơ. Kết quả Aedes aegypti làloài chiếm ưu thế với các chỉ số véc tơ ở mức cao, trong đó chỉ số mật độ muỗi (DI) dao động từ 1,0–2,20con/nhà và chỉ số Breteau (BI) từ 39,0–83,0. Ngược lại, Aedes albopictus có các chỉ số khá thấp, với DI từ0,01–0,06 con/nhà và BI từ 1,0–29,0. Cả hai loài đều phân bố cao hơn tại khu vực đồi núi và đồng ruộng,thấp hơn tại khu vực đô thị được chọn trong nghiên cứu. Các yếu tố có mối liên quan đến xuất hiện muỗivà bọ gậy Aedes bao gồm: nhà có sân vườn, sử dụng nước giếng, bể/phuy không đậy kín và vệ sinh ngoàinhà chưa đạt. Cần tăng cường hoạt động giám sát véc tơ, đẩy mạnh các giải pháp loại bỏ ổ bọ gậy tại hộgia đình nhằm góp phần phòng chống bệnh hiệu quả.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Nghiên cứu nhằm mục tiêu mô tả sự phân bố quần thể muỗi truyền bệnh sốt xuất huyết Dengue và một số yếu tố liên quan tại một số khu vực tỉnh Đắk Lắk năm 2025.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Nghiên cứu cắt ngang thực hiện tại 300 hộ gia đình.
analysis.methods: Sử dụng phiếu theo mẫu của Bộ Y tế để thu thập số liệu véc tơ.
analysis.main_results: Kết quả cho thấy Aedes aegypti là loài chiếm ưu thế với các chỉ số véc tơ ở mức cao, trong đó chỉ số mật độ muỗi (DI) dao động từ 1,0–2,20 con/nhà và chỉ số Breteau (BI) từ 39,0–83,0. Ngược lại, Aedes albopictus có các chỉ số khá thấp, với DI từ 0,01–0,06 con/nhà và BI từ 1,0–29,0.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Cả hai loài đều phân bố cao hơn tại khu vực đồi núi và đồng ruộng, thấp hơn tại khu vực đô thị được chọn trong nghiên cứu.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to describe the distribution of dengue vector populations and associated factors in selected areas of Dak Lak province in 2025. A cross-sectional study was conducted across 300 households, using a standardized form from the Ministry of Health to collect vector data. Results showed that Aedes aegypti was the dominant species with high vector indices, ranging from 1.0–2.20 mosquitoes per house and 39.0–83.0 Breteau indices. In contrast, Aedes albopictus had lower indices, from 0.01–0.06 mosquitoes per house and 1.0–29.0 Breteau indices. Both species were more prevalent in mountainous and rice fields areas compared to urban zones. Factors associated with Aedes presence included having a garden, using well water, unsealed containers, and poor household hygiene. The study highlights the need for enhanced vector surveillance and household interventions to effectively prevent dengue.

title: Interferon gamma and inflammatory response genes by weighted gene co-expression network analysis reveal significant associations with severe dengue infection in India
abstract: Objective Dengue virus, with four serotypes (DENV 1-4), is transmitted by Aedes aegypti. India carries 34% of global cases, yet studies to understand how the immune system reacts to dengue infection remain limited. Design This study uncovers early transcriptional signatures from whole blood of 112 NS1 positive hospital reported dengue patients and dissect biological processes linked to varying disease severities "with (WS) and without (-WS) warning signs". Results Differential gene expression analysis showed suppressed innate response in WS patients, with downregulated cytokines (CXCL8, CXCL16, CXCL2, IL1B) and disrupted platelet function. Upregulation was observed in genes related to glycosylation, nervous system, and metabolism. WGCNA module-trait analysis identified interferon response and inflammation as positively correlated with platelet count, highlighting key genes, IFI44L, IFI35, OAS1, HERC6 and SAMDL9 contributing to comparative severe outcomes. CTTN involved in maintenance of vascular permeability showed highest significant association with low platelet count. IFI44L emerged as a significant marker, showing highest transcript count difference between patients with platelet counts below 100 × 10^9/L and those between 100 and 140 × 10^9/L. Conclusion This study advances understanding of dengue infection and identifying probable clinical biomarkers at the initial phase of infection. These findings might hold potential for improving diagnostic and therapeutic strategies.

India carries 34% of global cases, yet studies to understand how the immune system reacts to dengue infection remain limited.

CTTN involved in maintenance of vascular permeability showed highest significant association with low platelet count.

title_zh: 干扰素γ和炎症反应基因通过加权基因共表达网络分析揭示与印度重症登革热感染的显著关联
source_body_en: Objective Dengue virus, with four serotypes (DENV 1-4), is transmitted by Aedes aegypti. India carries 34% of global cases, yet studies to understand how the immune system reacts to dengue infection remain limited. Design This study uncovers early transcriptional signatures from whole blood of 112 NS1 positive hospital reported dengue patients and dissect biological processes linked to varying disease severities "with (WS) and without (-WS) warning signs". Results Differential gene expression analysis showed suppressed innate response in WS patients, with downregulated cytokines (CXCL8, CXCL16, CXCL2, IL1B) and disrupted platelet function. Upregulation was observed in genes related to glycosylation, nervous system, and metabolism. WGCNA module-trait analysis identified interferon response and inflammation as positively correlated with platelet count, highlighting key genes, IFI44L, IFI35, OAS1, HERC6 and SAMDL9 contributing to comparative severe outcomes. CTTN involved in maintenance of vascular permeability showed highest significant association with low platelet count. IFI44L emerged as a significant marker, showing highest transcript count difference between patients with platelet counts below 100 × 10^9/L and those between 100 and 140 × 10^9/L. Conclusion This study advances understanding of dengue infection and identifying probable clinical biomarkers at the initial phase of infection. These findings might hold potential for improving diagnostic and therapeutic strategies.
abstract_zh: 目的 登革病毒 有四种血清型(DENV 1-4),由埃及伊蚊传播。印度病例占全球病例的 34%,但了解免疫系统如何应对登革热感染的研究仍然有限。设计 这项研究揭示了医院报告的 112 名 NS1 阳性登革热患者全血的早期转录特征,并剖析了与不同疾病严重程度“有(WS)和没有(-WS)警告信号”相关的生物过程。结果差异基因表达分析显示 WS 患者的先天反应受到抑制,细胞因子(CXCL8、CXCL16、CXCL2、IL1B)下调且血小板功能受损。在与糖基化、神经系统和代谢相关的基因中观察到上调。WGCNA 模块特征分析发现干扰素反应和炎症与血小板计数呈正相关,突出显示了导致相对严重结果的关键基因 IFI44L、IFI35、OAS1、HERC6 和 SAMDL9。CTTN 参与维持血管通透性,与低血小板计数显示出最显着的相关性。IFI44L 成为一个重要的标记物,显示血小板计数低于 100 × 10^9/L 的患者和血小板计数在 100 至 140 × 10^9/L 之间的患者之间转录本计数差异最高。结论 这项研究增进了对登革热感染的理解并确定了感染初始阶段可能的临床生物标志物。这些发现可能具有改善诊断和治疗策略的潜力。

title: Peningkatan pengetahuan Masyarakat dalam Pencegahan Demam Berdarah Dengue melalui Edukasi Kesehatan di Desa Bontolangkasa Utara, Kecamatan Bontonompo
abstract: Pada tahun 2024, Indonesia mencatat lebih dari 257 ribu kasus DBD dengan 1.461 kematian. Kabupaten Gowa tercatat sebagai salah satu kabupaten dengan kasus DBD tertinggi di Sulawesi Selatan. Rendahnya pengetahuan masyarakat mengenai vektor penular, siklus hidup nyamuk, dan gerakan 3M Plus menjadi salah satu penghambat utama keberhasilan Pemberantasan Sarang Nyamuk (PSN). Kegiatan pengabdian masyarakat ini bertujuan meningkatkan pengetahuan warga Desa Bontolangkasa Utara, Kecamatan Bontonompo, Kabupaten Gowa, mengenai pencegahan dan pengendalian DBD melalui penyuluhan. Desain kegiatan adalah one-group pretest-posttest dengan kuesioner 10 pernyataan benar-salah mencakup perilaku menggigit nyamuk Aedes aegypti, tempat perindukan, siklus hidup nyamuk, gejala DBD, gerakan 3M, fogging, larvasida abate, kelambu, dan program Satu Rumah Satu Jumantik. Sebanyak 24 peserta mengikuti pre-test dan post-test dan seluruhnya berhasil dipasangkan untuk analisis. Mayoritas peserta perempuan (95,8%) dengan rerata usia 44,33±9,88 tahun dan bekerja sebagai ibu rumah tangga (87,5%). Rerata skor pengetahuan meningkat dari 4,38±2,08 (pre-test) menjadi 8,92±0,97 (post-test) pada skala 0–10, atau meningkat 103,8%. Uji normalitas Shapiro-Wilk terhadap selisih skor menunjukkan distribusi tidak normal (p=0,012), sehingga uji Wilcoxon signed-rank digunakan sebagai analisis utama dan menunjukkan perbedaan yang sangat bermakna (p<0,001), didukung uji paired t-test sebagai analisis sensitivitas (t=10,89; df=23; p<0,001) dengan besar pengaruh yang sangat besar (Cohen's d=2,22). Proporsi peserta berkategori pengetahuan baik meningkat dari 8,3% menjadi 91,7%. Penyuluhan kesehatan berbasis evaluasi kuantitatif terbukti sangat efektif meningkatkan pengetahuan masyarakat tentang pencegahan DBD dan dapat menjadi model intervensi promosi kesehatan yang direplikasi di wilayah endemis DBD lain, dengan penguatan berkelanjutan melalui peran kader Jumantik dan pemerintah desa.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to improve community knowledge about dengue prevention in Desa Bontolangkasa Utara, Kabupaten Gowa, Indonesia, where dengue disease remains a significant public health concern. Using a one-group pretest-posttest design, 24 participants, primarily female housewives, were assessed before and after a health education intervention. The intervention included a 10-item true-false questionnaire covering topics such as Aedes aegypti behavior, 3M Plus activities, and dengue symptoms. The mean knowledge score increased from 4.38±2.08 to 8.92±0.97 on a 0–10 scale, representing a 103.8% improvement. The results were statistically significant (p<0.001) using both Wilcoxon signed-rank test and paired t-test, with a large effect size (Cohen's d=2.22). The proportion of participants with good knowledge increased from 8.3% to 91.7%. The study suggests that health education can be an effective tool for improving community understanding of dengue prevention, potentially serving as a model for other endemic areas. However, the lack of a control group and small sample size limit the confidence in the findings, resulting in a moderate evidence strength assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在通过提高社区对预防和控制措施的了解来解决登革热疾病的公共卫生问题,因为登革热仍然是印度尼西亚的一个重大健康问题,2024 年记录了超过 257,000 例病例和 1,461 例死亡。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在 Desa Bontolangkasa Utara、Kecamatan Bontonompo、Kabupaten Gowa 进行,采用一组前测后测设计。共有 24 名参与者,全部为女性,平均年龄为 44.33±9.88 岁,主要从事家庭主妇工作。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用基于定量评估的健康教育干预措施,使用测试前和测试后问卷,包含 10 个真假陈述,涵盖埃及伊蚊叮咬行为、蚊子繁殖地点、蚊子生命周期、登革热症状、3M Plus 活动、雾化、幼虫减少、蚊帐和“一屋一 Jumantik”计划等主题。
elements_zh.main_results: 平均知识得分从 4.38±2.08(测试前)增加到 8.92±0.97(测试后)(0-10 分),增长了 103.8%。使用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验和配对 t 检验,差异具有统计学显着性 (p<0.001),且效应量较大 (Cohen's d=2.22)。具有良好知识的参与者比例从8.3%上升到91.7%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 健康教育干预措施被认为在提高社区登革热预防知识方面非常有效,分数显着提高,知识分类发生显着转变,这表明在流行地区开展健康促进的一种新方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,有针对性的健康教育可以显着增强社区对登革热预防的了解,这可能会在 Jumantik 干部和地方政府的持续支持下复制这一模式,从而为登革热流行地区未来的公共卫生战略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到单组前测后测设计的限制,该设计缺乏对照组,而且样本量较小,只有 24 名参与者。尽管存在这些局限性,但结果得到了稳健的统计分析的支持,表明证据强度处于中等水平。

abstract: Sốt xuất huyết Dengue (SXHD) là bệnh truyền nhiễm lưu hành ở mức cao tại tỉnh Khánh Hòa trong nhiềunăm. Nghiên cứu mô tả cắt ngang hồi cứu được thực hiện nhằm mô tả sự thay đổi đặc điểm dịch tễ họcSXHD tại Khánh Hòa giai đoạn 2018-2024. Phân tích mô tả kết hợp phân tích chuỗi thời gian ngắt quãng(Interrupted Time Series Analysis) được sử dụng để đánh giá xu hướng biến động số ca mắc theo thờigian. Giai đoạn nghiên cứu có tổng cộng 45.828 trường hợp mắc SXHD và 11 trường hợp tử vong doSXHD. title_original: Sự thay đổi một số đặc điểm dịch tễ học của bệnh sốt xuất huyết dengue tại Khánh Hòa giai đoạn 2018-2024 Changes in the epidemiological characteristics of dengue in Khanh Hoa province, 2018-2024

analysis.research_question_and_background: Nghiên cứu được thực hiện nhằm mô tả sự thay đổi đặc điểm dịch tễ học của bệnh sốt xuất huyết dengue tại Khánh Hòa giai đoạn 2018-2024, do bệnh này là một dịch bệnh truyền nhiễm lưu hành ở mức cao tại tỉnh trong nhiều năm.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Nghiên cứu mô tả cắt ngang hồi cứu được thực hiện tại Khánh Hòa, Việt Nam, từ năm 2018 đến 2024, bao gồm tổng cộng 45.828 trường hợp mắc sốt xuất huyết dengue và 11 trường hợp tử vong do bệnh này.
analysis.methods: Phân tích mô tả kết hợp phân tích chuỗi thời gian ngắt quãng (Interrupted Time Series Analysis) được sử dụng để đánh giá xu hướng biến động số ca mắc theo thời gian.
analysis.main_results: Giai đoạn nghiên cứu ghi nhận bệnh SXHD xuất hiện quanh năm, với xu hướng gia tăng vào các tháng cuối năm; đỉnh dịch lớn nhất được ghi nhận vào tháng 11 năm 2020 với 2.397 trường hợp mắc/tháng.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Kết quả cho thấy sự thay đổi đáng kể trong đặc điểm dịch tễ học của SXHD, đặc biệt là sự gia tăng vào cuối năm và đỉnh dịch lớn nhất vào tháng 11 năm 2020.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Tình hình dịch SXHD tại Khánh Hòa cho thấy sự cần thiết của việc theo dõi và điều chỉnh các biện pháp kiểm soát dịch bệnh theo mùa và theo thời điểm.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Nghiên cứu dựa trên dữ liệu từ báo cáo y tế, có thể bị ảnh hưởng bởi độ chính xác của dữ liệu thu thập và không cung cấp thông tin chi tiết về các yếu tố gây ra sự thay đổi dịch tễ học, do đó mức độ tin cậy được đánh giá là trung bình.

analysis.summary_en: This study describes the epidemiological changes of dengue in Khanh Hoa province from 2018 to 2024, highlighting a significant increase in cases during the last months of the year, with the highest outbreak recorded in November 2020. The research used a cross-sectional retrospective design combined with interrupted time series analysis to evaluate trends in dengue incidence over time. The findings indicate that dengue remains a prevalent infectious disease in the region, with seasonal variations and a notable peak in 2020. The study suggests the importance of monitoring and adjusting disease control measures according to seasonal patterns. However, the research is limited by its reliance on reported data and lack of detailed causal analysis, resulting in moderate confidence in the evidence.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项回顾性横断面研究在中国越南的康宁省进行,时间为2018年至2024年,共包括45.828例登革热病例和11例因该病死亡的病例。

elements_zh.main_results: Giai đoạn nghiên cứu ghi nhận bệnh SXHD xuất hiện quanh năm,với xu hướng gia tăng vào các tháng cuối năm;2020 年 11 月 2.397 日,时间为 2.397 小时。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明登革热的流行病学特征发生了显著变化,尤其是年底病例数增加以及2020年11月出现的最大疫情高峰。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 广宁省登革热疫情情况表明,有必要根据季节和时间调整传染病监测和控制措施。

title: Prévention de la dengue à Wassakara : enquête sur les connaissances, attitudes et pratiques, Yopougon-Est, Côte d’Ivoire, 2025
abstract: Introduction : La dengue est une maladie infectieuse transmise par des moustiques et qui connaît une forte croissance en Afrique de l’Ouest, notamment en Côte d’Ivoire. Malgré les efforts des institutions sanitaires, la maladie reste sous-diagnostiquée et difficile à contrôler, particulièrement dans les zones urbaines et périurbaines comme Abidjan. Cette étude s’est focalisée sur Wassakara, un quartier défavorisé de la commune de Yopougon à Abidjan, afin d’évaluer les connaissances, attitudes et pratiques (CAP) des adultes concernant la prévention contre la dengue. Méthode : Une enquête transversale a été menée auprès de 316 adultes sélectionnés aléatoirement. Un questionnaire structuré a permis de recueillir des données sociodémographiques et le niveau de CAP. Les analyses statistiques ont inclus des tests du khi-deux et des régressions logistiques pour identifier les facteurs influents. Résultats : Si la majorité (94,3 %) connaît l’existence de la dengue, les connaissances spécifiques sur sa transmission, ses symptômes et la prévention sont insuffisantes : seuls 7,6 % ont obtenu un score de connaissances satisfaisant, et à peine 2,8 % adoptaient régulièrement des pratiques protectrices. La mobilisation lors des campagnes de salubrité était faible. Les facteurs associés à de meilleurs scores sont l’âge, le niveau d’éducation, la taille du ménage et l’engagement collectif. Conclusion : L’étude conclut à la nécessité d’intensifier les actions ciblées d’éducation sanitaire, la formation des agents communautaires et la fourniture de moyens adaptés. Une stratégie multisectorielle et participative est indispensable pour renforcer la résilience communautaire.

analysis.summary_en: This study conducted in Wassakara, a disadvantaged neighborhood in Yopougon, Abidjan, Côte d’Ivoire, aimed to assess the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (CAP) of adults regarding dengue prevention. A cross-sectional survey of 316 randomly selected adults revealed that while most were aware of dengue, their specific knowledge about transmission, symptoms, and prevention was limited, with only 7.6% achieving a satisfactory knowledge score and 2.8% regularly adopting protective practices. The analyses identified age, education level, household size, and collective engagement as factors associated with better CAP scores. The authors emphasized the need for targeted health education, community agent training, and resource provision to improve dengue prevention. They also called for a multi-sectoral and participatory strategy to enhance community resilience. The study highlights the importance of addressing knowledge gaps and mobilizing communities in dengue control efforts, but its reliance on self-reported data and cross-sectional design limits the depth and generalizability of its findings.

title_zh: 瓦萨卡拉预防登革热:了解、态度和实践,约普贡东部,科特迪瓦,2025 年
source_body_en: Introduction : La dengue est une maladie infectieuse transmise par des moustiques et qui connaît une forte croissance en Afrique de l’Ouest, notamment en Côte d’Ivoire. Malgré les efforts des institutions sanitaires, la maladie reste sous-diagnostiquée et difficile à contrôler, particulièrement dans les zones urbaines et périurbaines comme Abidjan. Cette étude s’est focalisée sur Wassakara, un quartier défavorisé de la commune de Yopougon à Abidjan, afin d’évaluer les connaissances, attitudes et pratiques (CAP) des adultes concernant la prévention contre la dengue. Méthode : Une enquête transversale a été menée auprès de 316 adultes sélectionnés aléatoirement. Un questionnaire structuré a permis de recueillir des données sociodémographiques et le niveau de CAP. Les analyses statistiques ont inclus des tests du khi-deux et des régressions logistiques pour identifier les facteurs influents. Résultats : Si la majorité (94,3 %) connaît l’existence de la dengue, les connaissances spécifiques sur sa transmission, ses symptômes et la prévention sont insuffisantes : seuls 7,6 % ont obtenu un score de connaissances satisfaisant, et à peine 2,8 % adoptaient régulièrement des pratiques protectrices. La mobilisation lors des campagnes de salubrité était faible. Les facteurs associés à de meilleurs scores sont l’âge, le niveau d’éducation, la taille du ménage et l’engagement collectif. Conclusion : L’étude conclut à la nécessité d’intensifier les actions ciblées d’éducation sanitaire, la formation des agents communautaires et la fourniture de moyens adaptés. Une stratégie multisectorielle et participative est indispensable pour renforcer la résilience communautaire.

title: Arbovirus diagnostics: from conventional methods to emerging technologies—a chikungunya virus-centric review
abstract: Arboviruses remain an important global health concern because of their expanding distribution, diverse transmission patterns, and the challenges associated with accurate and timely diagnosis. This review is centered on Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) as a representative model, focusing on diagnostic strategies across different stages of infection and the key diagnostic pitfalls that affect CHIKV detection in co-circulation settings. In this review, we summarize current laboratory-based approaches for CHIKV detection and differential diagnosis, including virus isolation, antigen detection, nucleic acid amplification and serological assays, with discussion of their applications, strengths and limitations. We further review recent developments in emerging diagnostic technologies, including next-generation sequencing, CRISPR-based detection methods, aptamer-based recognition systems, biosensors, and point-of-care testing platforms, highlighting their potential advantages and current limitations. Comparative examples involving dengue virus (DENV) and Zika virus (ZIKV) are discussed specifically to illustrate cross-reactivity and misclassification risks relevant to CHIKV diagnosis. Particular attention is given to persistent issues affecting diagnostic accuracy and practical implementation, including serological cross-reactivity among co-circulating arboviruses and the challenges of translating advanced technologies into accessible tools for field and resource-limited settings. Overall, this review summarizes progress in CHIKV-relevant diagnostics and outlines future opportunities for developing more reliable, rapid, and widely applicable detection strategies.

title: Arbovirus circulation in Brazil: a scoping review protocol
abstract: Arboviruses transmitted by Aedes species—predominantly Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus—represent a major public health challenge in Brazil. The co-circulation, re-emergence, and recurring epidemics of Dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), alongside the potential re-urbanization risk of Yellow Fever virus (YFV) over recent decades, have imposed severe health, social, and economic burdens across diverse geographic regions. Despite extensive epidemiological surveillance and research, literature remains fragmented regarding local variations in infection frequency, population susceptibility, diagnostic approaches, and regional disease burdens. A systematic mapping of published evidence—specifically focusing on human infection and exposure evidenced by laboratory detection methods (molecular, serological, or viral isolation)—is necessary to synthesize current knowledge, delineate spatial-temporal patterns, and identify critical evidence gaps in Aedes-borne arboviral research across Brazilian urban and peri-urban environments.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决对巴西伊蚊(尤其是 登革病毒)传播的虫媒病毒相关的感染频率、人群易感性、诊断方法和区域疾病负担的当地差异的零碎理解。这项研究的动机是这些病毒带来的重大公共卫生挑战,这些病毒给不同地理区域造成了严重的健康、社会和经济负担。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该范围审查协议概述了已发表证据的系统图谱,重点关注人类感染和接触 登革病毒 和其他伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒,特别是在巴西城市和城郊环境中。该研究跨越近几十年来,包括 登革病毒、寨卡病毒、基孔肯雅病毒的共同传播、重新出现和反复流行以及黄热病病毒潜在的再城市化风险的数据。
elements_zh.methods: 该审查将系统地绘制已发表的证据,特别关注通过分子、血清学或病毒分离技术等​​实验室检测方法证明的人类感染和暴露。该研究将综合现有知识,描绘时空模式,并确定巴西城市和城郊环境中伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒研究中的关键证据差距。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究报告称,关于巴西 登革病毒 和其他伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒相关的感染频率、人群易感性、诊断方法和区域疾病负担的当地差异,文献仍然支离破碎。它强调需要全面综合当前的知识来弥补这些差距。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,零碎的文献需要进行系统绘图,以更好地了解巴西 登革病毒 和其他伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒的空间和时间动态。这种方法的新颖之处在于它侧重于综合当前知识并确定关键证据差距。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为有针对性的 监测、改进的诊断策略和更有效的公共卫生干预措施提供信息,以减轻巴西 监测 和其他伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒的影响。他们还强调了解决疾病负担和感染模式的区域差异的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于范围审查方案,不提供原始结果。证据仅是抽象的,由于缺乏详细数据和审查的探索性,研究结果的可信度较低。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该范围审查协议概述了已发表证据的系统图谱,重点关注人类感染和接触 登革病毒 和其他伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒,特别是在巴西城市和城郊环境中。该研究跨越近几十年来,包括 登革病毒、寨卡病毒、基孔肯雅病毒的共同传播、重新出现和反复流行以及黄热病病毒潜在的再城市化风险的数据。
analysis_zh.methods: 该审查将系统地绘制已发表的证据,特别关注通过分子、血清学或病毒分离技术等​​实验室检测方法证明的人类感染和暴露。该研究将综合现有知识,描绘时空模式,并确定巴西城市和城郊环境中伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒研究中的关键证据差距。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该研究报告称,关于巴西 登革病毒 和其他伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒相关的感染频率、人群易感性、诊断方法和区域疾病负担的当地差异,文献仍然支离破碎。它强调需要全面综合当前的知识来弥补这些差距。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,零碎的文献需要进行系统绘图,以更好地了解巴西 登革病毒 和其他伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒的空间和时间动态。这种方法的新颖之处在于它侧重于综合当前知识并确定关键证据差距。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为有针对性的 监测、改进的诊断策略和更有效的公共卫生干预措施提供信息,以减轻巴西 监测 和其他伊蚊传播的虫媒病毒的影响。他们还强调了解决疾病负担和感染模式的区域差异的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于范围审查方案,不提供原始结果。证据仅是抽象的,由于缺乏详细数据和审查的探索性,研究结果的可信度较低。

title: A dengue sob uma perspectiva epidemiológica e sociodemográfica: uma análise sobre o estado de Minas Gerais
abstract: O contexto epidemiológico da dengue no Brasil caracteriza-se por oscilações entre períodos endêmicos e surtos epidêmicos, representando um desafio contínuo à saúde pública. Este estudo tem como objetivo geral analisar o perfil epidemiológico e sociodemográfico da dengue no estado de Minas Gerais, com ênfase no município de Uberlândia, a partir de evidências da literatura científica recente. Trata-se de uma pesquisa bibliográfica, de caráter descritivo e exploratório, realizada em bases de dados nacionais e internacionais. Os resultados indicam elevada incidência da doença em determinados períodos do ano, forte associação com fatores socioambientais, desigualdades regionais e impacto significativo sobre o Sistema Único de Saúde. Conclui-se que a dengue permanece como um importante problema de saúde pública em Minas Gerais, exigindo estratégias integradas de vigilância epidemiológica, controle vetorial e ações intersetoriais.

The research reveals high seasonal incidence of dengue, strong associations with socio-environmental factors, regional disparities, and significant impacts on the Unified Health System. The authors conclude that dengue remains a major public health challenge in the region, necessitating integrated approaches to surveillance, vector control, and intersectoral interventions. While the study's bibliographic nature limits its scope, the use of current scientific evidence provides moderate confidence in its conclusions and recommendations for addressing dengue's multifaceted challenges.

analysis_zh.main_results: 结果表明,在一年中的某些时段,登革热的 发病率 较高,与社会环境因素、区域不平等密切相关,并对统一卫生系统产生重大影响。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,登革热仍然是米纳斯吉拉斯州的一个重大公共卫生问题,需要采取流行病学 监测、媒介 控制和跨部门行动的综合策略。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明需要采取综合的 监测 和控制策略,强调解决社会环境因素和区域不平等以减轻登革热对卫生系统影响的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对书目研究的依赖而受到限制,书目研究可能无法捕获所有当前或本地数据;然而,最近科学证据的使用为研究结果提供了适度的可信度。

title: Priming and boosting the investigator pipeline for patient-oriented arboviral research
abstract: This project is anchored in Dr. Matthew Collins’ sustained and growing career as a leader in translational arbovirology research and clinical work in Infectious Diseases and Travel Medicine, with the work proposed here growing out of an ongoing clinical trial designed to better understand protective immunity to dengue virus. As an Associate Professor in the Division of Infectious Diseases in the Emory University School of Medicine, he has been involved in patient-oriented research (POR) since his undergraduate experiences in the Vascular Biology Center at the Medical College of Georgia, a public institution charged with improving health outcomes for patients in Georgia. Ultimately pursuing an MD, PhD out of an interest and motivation to realize improved patient outcomes via rigorous discovery science, Collins developed ardent interest in tropical and emerging diseases, particularly vector-borne diseases, which represent a solvable global health problem that imposes a massive disease burden on human populations. This project will focus on a group of closely related viruses called flaviviruses – which includes dengue, Zika, yellow fever, and West Nile – while addressing a fundament gap in knowledge for many viruses: Does a combination of different exposures confer better immunity to a given virus? Leveraging a unique set of human samples, tools, and reagents, we will examine the breadth of flavivirus immunity generated by sequential vaccination with different dengue vaccines and assess how dengue infection impacts the strength and durability of protective immunity to yellow fever. Data generated in this study will have direct implications for ongoing product development as well as public health policy for existing approaches to preventing flavivirus infections. To accomplish the scientific goals of this project and his greater career goals, Dr. Collins has established a comprehensive career development plan that includes connection to a team of advisors, mentors, and collaborators and a focused set of knowledge (vaccinology), skills (biostatistics and trial design) and leadership (team science, academic career development and mentorship) building and training activities. These endeavors are largely accomplished via existing resources available at Emory University and include Clinical Research Bootcamp (Emory), a Vaccinology symposium (Keystone), ADVAC (Advanced course in vaccinology (U of Geneva)), and COMPASS (Career Optimization and Mentoring Program for Academic Success and Support, Emory School of Medicine). Finally, this proposal creates rich opportunities to recruit and mentor trainees in POR. Collins’ commitment to POR has been matched by a strong record of NIH and foundational funding and mentorship. His portfolio of mentees includes undergraduates, masters and doctoral students, medical residents and fellows, and postdocs. This proposal increases Dr. Collins’ abilities and effort in cultivating the next generation of POR investigators. The environment at Emory University affords a deep pool of talented mentees who will benefit from opportunities in team science, interdisciplinary arbovirology, and robust training in experimental design, advanced analyses, and science communication via projects that substantially contribute to ongoing efforts to improve human health and diminish arboviral disease.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aims to address a fundamental gap in understanding whether a combination of different exposures enhances immunity to dengue virus.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is an ongoing clinical trial designed to better understand protective immunity to dengue virus, involving human samples and focusing on sequential vaccination with different dengue vaccines.
analysis.methods: The methods include leveraging a unique set of human samples, tools, and reagents to examine the breadth of flavivirus immunity generated by sequential vaccination and assess the impact of dengue infection on yellow fever immunity.
analysis.main_results: The study directly observes the breadth of flavivirus immunity generated by sequential vaccination with different dengue vaccines and evaluates how dengue infection affects the strength and durability of protective immunity to yellow fever.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the findings will contribute to understanding the immune responses to dengue and related flaviviruses, offering novel insights into the potential benefits of combined exposures.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform ongoing product development and public health policy for preventing flavivirus infections, particularly dengue and yellow fever.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on an ongoing clinical trial, which may have limitations in generalizability and control, but the study's design and focus on dengue virus provide a moderate level of confidence in its conclusions.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores whether sequential vaccination with different dengue vaccines enhances immunity to dengue virus and how dengue infection affects protective immunity to yellow fever. The research is grounded in an ongoing clinical trial and leverages unique human samples to examine immune responses. The findings aim to improve understanding of flavivirus immunity and inform vaccine development and public health strategies. While the study provides valuable insights, its reliance on an ongoing trial may limit generalizability, resulting in moderate confidence in the conclusions.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一项正在进行的临床试验,旨在更好地了解对 登革病毒 的保护性免疫力,涉及人体样本,并重点关注不同登革热 疫苗 的连续 疫苗接种。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法包括利用一组独特的人类样本、工具和试剂来检查连续 疫苗接种 产生的黄病毒免疫的广度,并评估登革热感染对黄热病免疫的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究直接观察了连续疫苗接种与不同登革热疫苗产生的黄病毒免疫的广度,并评估登革热感染如何影响黄热病保护性免疫的强度和持久性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,这些发现将有助于了解 免疫应答 对登革热和相关黄病毒的影响,为联合暴露的潜在益处提供新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为正在进行的预防黄病毒感染(特别是登革热和黄热病)的产品开发和公共卫生政策提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该证据基于正在进行的临床试验,该试验可能在普遍性和控制方面存在局限性,但该研究的设计和对 登革病毒 的关注为其结论提供了中等程度的可信度。

abstract_zh: 该项目以 Matthew Collins 博士作为传染病和旅行医学转化虫媒病毒学研究和临床工作领导者持续不断发展的职业生涯为基础,这里提出的工作源于一项正在进行的临床试验,旨在更好地了解 登革病毒 的保护性免疫。作为埃默里大学医学院传染病系的副教授,自乔治亚医学院血管生物学中心(一家负责改善乔治亚州患者健康结果的公共机构)本科学习起,他就一直参与以患者为导向的研究 (POR)。最终,柯林斯出于通过严格的发现科学来改善患者治疗效果的兴趣和动机,攻读了医学博士、博士学位,他对热带和新出现的疾病,特别是 媒介 传播的疾病产生了浓厚的兴趣,这些疾病代表了一个可解决的全球健康问题,给人类带来了巨大的疾病负担。该项目将重点关注一组密切相关的黄病毒病毒(包括登革热、寨卡病毒、黄热病和西尼罗河病毒),同时解决许多病毒的基本知识空白:不同暴露的组合是否会对特定病毒产生更好的免疫力?利用一套独特的人体样本、工具和试剂,我们将检查连续 疫苗接种 与不同登革热 疫苗 产生的黄病毒免疫的广度,并评估登革热感染如何影响黄热病保护性免疫的强度和持久性。这项研究产生的数据将对正在进行的产品开发以及预防黄病毒感染的现有方法的公共卫生政策产生直接影响。为了实现该项目的科学目标和他更大的职业目标,柯林斯博士制定了全面的职业发展计划,其中包括与顾问、导师和合作者团队的联系以及一系列重点知识(疫苗学)、技能(生物统计学和试验设计)和领导力(团队科学、学术职业发展和指导)建设和培训活动。这些努力主要是通过埃默里大学的现有资源完成的,包括临床研究训练营(埃默里)、疫苗学研讨会(Keystone)、ADVAC(疫苗学高级课程(日内瓦大学))和 COMPASS(埃默里医学院职业优化和学术成功与支持辅导计划)。最后,该提案为招募和指导 POR 学员创造了丰富的机会。柯林斯对 POR 的承诺与 NIH 的良好记录以及基金会的资助和指导相匹配。他的学员包括本科生、硕士生和博士生、住院医师和研究员以及博士后。该提案增加了 Collins 博士培养下一代 POR 研究人员的能力和努力。埃默里大学的环境为大量才华横溢的学员提供了机会,他们将受益于团队科学、跨学科虫媒病毒学的机会,以及通过项目进行的实验设计、高级分析和科学传播方面的强有力的培训,这些项目对改善人类健康和减少虫媒病毒疾病的持续努力做出了重大贡献。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决理解不同暴露组合是否可以增强对 登革病毒 免疫力的根本差距。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一项正在进行的临床试验,旨在更好地了解对 登革病毒 的保护性免疫力,涉及人体样本,并重点关注不同登革热 疫苗 的连续 疫苗接种。
analysis_zh.methods: 这些方法包括利用一组独特的人类样本、工具和试剂来检查连续 疫苗接种 产生的黄病毒免疫的广度,并评估登革热感染对黄热病免疫的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该研究直接观察了连续疫苗接种与不同登革热疫苗产生的黄病毒免疫的广度,并评估登革热感染如何影响黄热病保护性免疫的强度和持久性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,这些发现将有助于了解 免疫应答 对登革热和相关黄病毒的影响,为联合暴露的潜在益处提供新的见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为正在进行的预防黄病毒感染(特别是登革热和黄热病)的产品开发和公共卫生政策提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该证据基于正在进行的临床试验,该试验可能在普遍性和控制方面存在局限性,但该研究的设计和对 登革病毒 的关注为其结论提供了中等程度的可信度。

title: Analysis of Cell Populations from Arbovirus-Infected Tissues by Flow Cytometry.
abstract: Arboviruses still represent a major challenge to public health in many parts of the world. Despite shared epidemiological characteristics, each arboviral disorder displays distinct cellular tropism and activation patterns, progressing to immunopathological outcomes that remain not fully elucidated. A deeper understanding of these processes requires methodologies capable of characterizing the often-complex cellular responses. In this context, flow cytometry emerges as a valuable tool, enabling the characterization of heterogeneous cell populations, the assessment of activation and proliferation markers, the quantification of inflammatory mediators, and the detection of cell death pathways. By integrating these parameters, flow cytometry can enhance our understanding of arbovirus pathogenesis, clarify their cellular tropism, and understand immune responses to infection. This methodological article outlines the main steps for applying the technique to different target tissues infected by chikungunya, dengue, yellow fever, and Zika viruses, emphasizing the most effective strategies.

title_zh: 通过流式细胞术分析虫媒病毒感染组织的细胞群。
source_body_en: Arboviruses still represent a major challenge to public health in many parts of the world. Despite shared epidemiological characteristics, each arboviral disorder displays distinct cellular tropism and activation patterns, progressing to immunopathological outcomes that remain not fully elucidated. A deeper understanding of these processes requires methodologies capable of characterizing the often-complex cellular responses. In this context, flow cytometry emerges as a valuable tool, enabling the characterization of heterogeneous cell populations, the assessment of activation and proliferation markers, the quantification of inflammatory mediators, and the detection of cell death pathways. By integrating these parameters, flow cytometry can enhance our understanding of arbovirus pathogenesis, clarify their cellular tropism, and understand immune responses to infection. This methodological article outlines the main steps for applying the technique to different target tissues infected by chikungunya, dengue, yellow fever, and Zika viruses, emphasizing the most effective strategies.
abstract_zh: 虫媒病毒仍然是世界许多地区公共卫生的重大挑战。尽管具有共同的流行病学特征,但每种虫媒病毒性疾病都表现出不同的细胞向性和激活模式,并发展为尚未完全阐明的免疫病理学结果。要更深入地了解这些过程,需要能够表征通常复杂的细胞反应的方法。在这种背景下,流式细胞术成为一种有价值的工具,可以表征异质细胞群、评估活化和增殖标记、量化炎症介质以及检测细胞死亡途径。通过整合这些参数,流式细胞术可以增强我们对虫媒病毒发病机制的了解,阐明其细胞向性,并了解免疫应答的感染情况。这篇方法论文章概述了将该技术应用于受基孔肯雅热、登革热、黄热病和寨卡病毒感染的不同目标组织的主要步骤,强调了最有效的策略。

title: Development of a Single Thermal Cycling Multiplex RT-qPCR Assay for Rapid Arbovirus Detection
abstract: Background: The co-circulation of multiple arboviruses with similar clinical presentations poses a significant challenge for public health surveillance. This study aimed to develop and clinically validate a novel multiplex RT-qPCR assay for the simultaneous detection of five arboviruses in three reactions. Methods: A diagnostic accuracy study was conducted in Salvador, Brazil. Evaluation was performed using 254 prospective serum samples and 34 archived positive samples. The primers and probes for the assay were designed in silico, all targeting highly conserved regions of Dengue (DENV), Zika (ZIKV), Chikungunya (CHIKV), Oropouche (OROV), and West Nile (WNV) viruses. The protocol was optimized in three reactions with a single thermal cycle, comprising a tetraplex reaction (DENV, CHIKV, ZIKV, and hRNAseP, an endogenous control) and two singleplex reactions (OROV and WNV). Results: In prospective analysis, the assay identified 45 DENV, 3 CHIKV, and 9 OROV-positive cases. Diagnostic accuracy for DENV and CHIKV was 96% (95% CI: 93.3–98.0%), successfully detecting four DENV cases missed by the reference standard. Furthermore, incorporating OROV enabled the identification of nine cases that conventional triplex protocols would have overlooked. Conclusion: This single-cycling multiplex RT-qPCR assay enhances epidemiological surveillance by expanding detection beyond traditional triplex targets to include OROV and WNV. This operational optimization reduces turnaround times and prevents the underdiagnosis of emerging arboviruses, serving as a robust diagnostic tool for endemic regions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 具有相似临床表现的多种虫媒病毒的共同循环对公共卫生提出了重大挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在巴西萨尔瓦多进行了一项诊断准确性研究。使用 254 份前瞻性血清样本和 34 份存档的阳性样本进行评估。
elements_zh.methods: 该检测的引物和探针均通过计算机设计,均针对登革热 (DENV)、寨卡 (ZIKV)、基孔肯雅 (CHIKV)、奥罗普切 (OROV) 和西尼罗河 (WNV) 病毒的高度保守区域。该方案在单个热循环的三个反应中进行了优化,包括一个四重反应(DENV、CHIKV、ZIKV 和 hRNAseP,内源性对照)和两个单重反应(OROV 和 WNV)。
elements_zh.main_results: 在前瞻性分析中,该检测确定了 45 例 DENV、3 例 CHIKV 和 9 例 OROV 阳性病例。DENV 和 CHIKV 的诊断准确率为 96%(95% CI:93.3-98.0%),成功检出参考标准漏检的 4 例 DENV 病例。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这种单循环多重 RT-qPCR 检测将检测范围扩展到传统三重靶标之外,包括 OROV 和 WNV,从而增强了流行病学 监测。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这种操作优化缩短了周转时间,并防止对新兴虫媒病毒的诊断不足,成为流行地区的强大诊断工具。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告局限性或证据强度。

abstract_zh: 背景:具有相似临床表现的多种虫媒病毒的共同循环对公共卫生提出了重大挑战 监测。本研究旨在开发并临床验证一种新型多重 RT-qPCR 检测方法,用于在三个反应中同时检测五种虫媒病毒。方法:在巴西萨尔瓦多进行了一项诊断准确性研究。使用 254 份前瞻性血清样本和 34 份存档的阳性样本进行评估。该检测的引物和探针均通过计算机设计,均针对登革热 (DENV)、寨卡 (ZIKV)、基孔肯雅 (CHIKV)、奥罗普切 (OROV) 和西尼罗河 (WNV) 病毒的高度保守区域。该方案在单个热循环的三个反应中进行了优化,包括一个四重反应(DENV、CHIKV、ZIKV 和 hRNAseP,内源性对照)和两个单重反应(OROV 和 WNV)。结果:在前瞻性分析中,该检测确定了 45 例 DENV、3 例 CHIKV 和 9 例 OROV 阳性病例。DENV 和 CHIKV 的诊断准确率为 96%(95% CI:93.3-98.0%),成功检出参考标准漏检的 4 例 DENV 病例。此外,结合 OROV 可以识别传统三重协议可能忽略的九种情况。结论:这种单循环多重 RT-qPCR 检测将检测范围扩展到传统三重靶标之外,包括 OROV 和 WNV,从而增强了流行病学 监测。这种操作优化缩短了周转时间,并防止对新兴虫媒病毒的诊断不足,成为流行地区的强大诊断工具。

title: Superinfection Exclusion Between Japanese Encephalitis Virus Genotypes I and III Occurs During Viral Entry.
abstract: Superinfection exclusion occurs when a primary viral infection prevents subsequent infection of the same cell. Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV) comprises several genotypes that differ primarily in their envelope protein sequences, and a shift in predominance from genotype III (GIII) to genotype I (GI) has been observed in nature. However, the mechanisms contributing to this genotype replacement remain unclear. In this study, we examined superinfection exclusion between JEV GI and GIII in mammalian BHK-21 cells and mosquito C6/36 cells. Reciprocal exclusion was observed in both cell types. Further analysis in BHK-21 cells, using GIII as the primary virus and GI as the secondary virus, indicated that inhibition occurred at the viral entry stage. The extent of exclusion increased as the interval between primary GIII infection and secondary GI infection was prolonged, indicating that superinfection exclusion became progressively stronger over time. Quantitative analysis using fluorescently labeled GI virus and RT-qPCR further showed that GI entry was significantly reduced in cells previously infected with GIII compared with mock-infected controls. Transferrin uptake remained readily detectable in JEV-infected cells, suggesting that prior infection did not grossly impair transferrin internalization under the conditions examined. Together, these findings demonstrate superinfection exclusion between JEV GI and GIII and indicate that interference occurs predominantly during viral entry. The potential contribution of this phenomenon to JEV genotype replacement in nature warrants further investigation.

title: Clinical and epidemiological structure of imported infectious diseases in Moscow
abstract: The expansion of international tourism and increasing migration have led to a higher risk of the emergence and spread of various infectious diseases, including those that are not endemic to Russia. Therefore, studying the characteristics of infectious diseases in children and adults returning from international travel is of considerable importance. To analyze the clinical and epidemiological characteristics of imported infectious diseases in children and adults after international travel. Materials and Methods . We conducted a single-center retrospective cohort study at Infectious Clinical Hospital No. 1 of the Moscow Department of Health. Medical records of 2005 adults and 501 children who developed illness during or after international travel and were admitted to the hospital’s isolation ward after returning from abroad between 2009 and 2019 were retrospectively reviewed. Statistical analysis was performed using IBM SPSS Statistics version 26.0. The age of the study participants ranged from 1 month to 86 years. Among hospitalized patients, children 1–3 years accounted for the largest proportion (41.9 %). Children were hospitalized more frequently during the summer (176 cases, 35.1 %; p<0.001) and autumn (139 (27,7; 23,6-31,6), p<0,05), whereas adults were more commonly hospitalized in the winter (496 cases, 24.7 %; p<0.001) and in the spring (526 (26,2; 24,5–28,1), p<0,05). In the epidemiological history, travel to the Republic of Türkiye was most common among children (17.0 %), while travel to the Kingdom of Thailand predominated among adults (24.9 %). Compared with adults, children were more frequently diagnosed with enterovirus infection (37.0 % vs 19.2 %, p<0.001) among infections with a fecal-oral transmission route, and pertussis (1.5 % vs 0.1 %, p<0.05) among infections with an airborne transmission route. Among children, dengue fever was the most frequently diagnosed vector-borne infection (88.9 %). We identified the epidemiological characteristics and etiological structure of imported infectious diseases and demonstrated seasonal, geographic, and nosological differences in infectious diseases among children compared with adults after international travel.

title_zh: 莫斯科输入性传染病临床和流行病学结构
source_body_en: The expansion of international tourism and increasing migration have led to a higher risk of the emergence and spread of various infectious diseases, including those that are not endemic to Russia. Therefore, studying the characteristics of infectious diseases in children and adults returning from international travel is of considerable importance. To analyze the clinical and epidemiological characteristics of imported infectious diseases in children and adults after international travel. Materials and Methods . We conducted a single-center retrospective cohort study at Infectious Clinical Hospital No. 1 of the Moscow Department of Health. Medical records of 2005 adults and 501 children who developed illness during or after international travel and were admitted to the hospital’s isolation ward after returning from abroad between 2009 and 2019 were retrospectively reviewed. Statistical analysis was performed using IBM SPSS Statistics version 26.0. The age of the study participants ranged from 1 month to 86 years. Among hospitalized patients, children 1–3 years accounted for the largest proportion (41.9 %). Children were hospitalized more frequently during the summer (176 cases, 35.1 %; p<0.001) and autumn (139 (27,7; 23,6-31,6), p<0,05), whereas adults were more commonly hospitalized in the winter (496 cases, 24.7 %; p<0.001) and in the spring (526 (26,2; 24,5–28,1), p<0,05). In the epidemiological history, travel to the Republic of Türkiye was most common among children (17.0 %), while travel to the Kingdom of Thailand predominated among adults (24.9 %). Compared with adults, children were more frequently diagnosed with enterovirus infection (37.0 % vs 19.2 %, p<0.001) among infections with a fecal-oral transmission route, and pertussis (1.5 % vs 0.1 %, p<0.05) among infections with an airborne transmission route. Among children, dengue fever was the most frequently diagnosed vector-borne infection (88.9 %). We identified the epidemiological characteristics and etiological structure of imported infectious diseases and demonstrated seasonal, geographic, and nosological differences in infectious diseases among children compared with adults after international travel.
